title: Okta or JumpCloud: Identity Platform vs Identity Plus Device Management
excerpt: Okta focuses on enterprise identity and access; JumpCloud combines directory, identity and device management in one platform aimed at small and mid-sized organisations.
verdict: Okta is the stronger choice for large organisations that need deep, advanced identity features and integrations. JumpCloud suits small and mid-sized teams that want identity and device management together in one simple platform at a lower starting price.
